narr: A weak cold front stalled across extreme northern Mississippi. Showers and thunderstorms with very heavy rain developed along this boundary. These storms were slow-moving resulting in some flash flooding.
ev: A store was flooded with ankle-deep water due to a sewer backup.
Nail Road was closed due to flooding between Highway 61 and Honeysuckle Lane.
A family had to be rescued from their mobile home by boat due to flooding. Several vehicles were damaged.
lsr: ANKLE DEEP WATER IN STORE DUE TO SEWER BACKUP.
NAIL ROAD CLOSED BETWEEN HIGHWAY 61 AND HONEYSUCKLE LANE.
FLOODING RESULTED IN A FAMILY BEING RESCUSED BY BOAT FROM THEIR MOBILE HOME. SEVERAL VEHICLES WERE DAMAGED FROM FLOODING.
